name: bilbasen-mcp
description: Search car listings on Bilbasen.dk, Denmark's largest used-car marketplace.
long_description: Three read-only tools that expose Bilbasen.dk to Claude: search with filters (price, year, mileage, fuel, gear, seller type), fetch full listing detail pages, and compute aggregate price/mileage/year statistics. The server transparently solves Bilbasen's AWS WAF JavaScript challenge with a headless Chromium and caches results in memory.

advanced_filters.title: Advanced search filters
advanced_filters.description: Expose the full filter set (towing, EV battery and charging, body type, colour, doors, seats, boot size, performance, economy, emissions, location and 171 equipment flags). Off by default because it roughly triples the size of the tool definitions Claude has to read in every conversation.

tools.name: bilbasen_get_listing
tools.description: Fetch full detail for a single listing by URL.

tools.name: bilbasen_price_stats
tools.description: Aggregate price, mileage and year statistics across matching listings.
